function.name: draft_briefly_post
function.description: Sends the extracted Briefly cluster facts to a high-intelligence Cloud LLM to draft a thought-provoking, standalone broadcast tweet. Use this immediately after receiving the article context from read_briefly_cluster.

target_url.description: The URL of the Briefly news cluster being published. You MUST include this.

article_context.description: The exact text or summary extracted from the previous read_briefly_cluster step.
